realistic_gain: No direct LB or private score gain in the default world (P~0.85-0.9). In the other ~10-15% of worlds (K2 error, d1 <= -0.002, twin >> K2, L(K2) > 8.0 h), it lets pre-registered rescues run (K1, a K2 resubmit, the K2'' deadline move) and avoids a strict-text fallback to #34 or exp52. Expected private effect is about +0.0000 to +0.0003, with a larger tail protection (for example, keeping the insertion's +0.001 when K2's runtime trips the gate). Its main value is integrity: OKs are timestamped before any score, so none are post-hoc. Cost: about 10 minutes, no Kaggle slot.
